description: This PHP source file enables exporting a module in the vtiger CRM system. It processes user requests to export a specific module, utilizes vtiger's Package and Module classes for packaging, and initiates the export process.

classes.name: Vtiger_Package
classes.description: Class responsible for handling package-related operations such as exporting modules.

classes.name: Vtiger_Module
classes.description: Class representing a module within vtiger, with methods to retrieve instances of modules.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Method to export a module package to a zip file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an instance of a module by name.
